children: Mama’s Creations reported second quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $54.6 million, up 55.0% year-over-year, and net income of $2.6 million, up 100.9% from the prior-year quarter. Adjusted EBITDA rose 68.9% to $5.5 million and the company ended the period with $138.6 million in cash following a July public offering. Management highlighted expanded retail placements, a Costco multi-vendor mailer selection, and the completion of the East Rutherford facility expansion.
Revenue: $54.6 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026, up 55.0% from $35.2 million a year ago.
Gross profit: $13.1 million (24.0% of revenue) for the quarter, up 49.1% versus prior-year quarter.
Operating income (Income from operations): $3.0 million for the quarter (as reported).
Net income: $2.6 million, or $0.06 diluted EPS, compared with $1.3 million, or $0.03 diluted EPS, in the year-ago quarter.
Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP): $5.5 million for the quarter, up 68.9% versus $3.3 million a year ago.
Launched over a dozen new retail placements in Q2, with more than 60% utilizing chicken bottoms; most were cross-sells into banners the company already serves.
Selected for Costco’s second-half national multi-vendor mailer across all eight regions, building on growth from ~$0.5M four years ago to over $25M in the last fiscal year.

Approved more than two dozen placements for delivery in Q3, including the company’s first planned launches in the Kroger banner (four items in 100+ Louisville stores) and expanded placements at multiple major retailers.
Completed East Rutherford facility expansion, adding freezer and refrigeration storage and upgraded employee amenities to reduce outside storage fees and support scaling operations.

Completed a public offering in July 2026 (full exercise of underwriters’ option) generating approximately $108.6 million net proceeds to support future M&A initiatives; cash and cash equivalents grew to $138.6 million as of July 31, 2026.

title: Mama’s Creations: Q2 Revenue +55% to $54.6M; Net Income Doubles to $2.6M
